verdict.rationale: Fivetran's evidence shows it positions itself as enabling downstream AI tools via a 'unified context layer' (fivetran-docs-7) and offers an AI Support Assistant for troubleshooting (fivetran-docs-44), but there is no evidence Fivetran itself analyzes synced data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions about that data inside the product. missing for 10: any documented in-product AI analytics/insights feature on the synced data, examples of AI-generated suggestions about data content, evidence beyond enabling third-party AI tools.
